name: Neutral-unbalance relay between two polyphase systems
aliases: in neutral between two multi-phase systems
summary: Relay form measuring current in a link joining the star points of two polyphase systems, such as split capacitor banks.
description: This form shows a current relay in the conductor that joins the neutral points of two star-connected polyphase systems. A familiar application is the double-star capacitor bank, where a CT in the link between the two star points detects unbalance caused by failed capacitor units.

In a healthy balanced arrangement the link carries little current, so the relay setting is a small fraction of phase current and must allow for natural unbalance. The symbol does not tell you the alarm and trip stages or the compensation for inherent unbalance; those are in the bank protection settings.
readingNotes: Identify the two star points joined by the measured link.
Look for separate alarm and trip stages.
drawingChecklist: Show the interconnecting link and CT
distinction: This relay measures the link between two star points; a neutral-current relay measures one neutral path to earth or to the supply.
